title: Selmer-Style S₅ Galois Group for x⁵ − x − 1

problemStatement.plain: Provide a second machine-verified example of a quintic over ℚ with non-solvable Galois group, using the classical "resolvent/discriminant" route rather than the Eisenstein criterion. For f = x⁵ − x − 1: (i) f is irreducible over ℚ (Selmer 1956 proved xⁿ − x − 1 is irreducible for all n); (ii) its discriminant is Δ = 2869 = 19·151, which is not a perfect square, so the Galois group is not contained in the alternating group A₅; (iii) f has exactly three real roots, so complex conjugation acts as a transposition. An irreducible quintic whose group contains a transposition and is not inside A₅ must be all of S₅, which is not solvable — a concrete witness to Abel–Ruffini.

This GIVES, in the STEM field K=Q(alpha), primes over 2 with inertia degrees exactly {2,3} matching f mod 2 = (X^2+X+1)(X^3+X^2+1). What remains genuinely absent: (1) p not dividing exponent theta -- here clean via disc(f)=2869=19*151 squarefree => O_K=Z[alpha] => exponent=1, but the squarefree-discriminant => monogenic theorem is NOT packaged (only the building block Algebra.discr_mul_isIntegral_mem_adjoin); (2) the stem-field {2,3} inertia degrees -> an order-6 (=lcm 2 3) Frobenius in the SPLITTING field; (3) the decomposition-group/Frobenius -> Perm(roots) cycle-type transport (no decompositionGroup/FrobeniusElt/arithFrobAt in Mathlib v4.26 NumberTheory). The headline Gal=S5 stays blocked, but the gap is now precisely 3 named sub-gaps, with sub-gap (2-producer) NEWLY AVAILABLE. insights: RE-SCOPE (r7 2026-06-20): the Dedekind/Frobenius blocker is NOT a single absent lemma. Mathlib v4.26 pin SHIPS the Kummer-Dedekind factorization<->inertia correspondence (NumberField/Ideal/KummerDedekind.lean, Roblot 2025: primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod + inertiaDeg_/ramificationIdx_..._symm_apply). It gives STEM-field (Q(alpha)) inertia degrees from the mod-p factor degrees, conditional on p not dividing RingOfIntegers.exponent theta. The genuinely-absent pieces are (B) squarefree-disc => O_K=Z[alpha] [only Algebra.discr_mul_isIntegral_mem_adjoin exists] and (C) the decomposition-group/Frobenius -> Perm(roots) cycle-type transport into the splitting field's Galois group [no decompositionGroup/FrobeniusElt/arithFrobAt in v4.26 NumberTheory]. Prior notes calling the whole correspondence 'absent' should be read as referring specifically to sub-gaps B and C.
VERIFIED (sympy/numpy): x⁵−x−1 has exactly ONE real root (≈1.1673), not three; 4 non-real roots = two conjugate pairs. Problem statement point (iii) is FALSE.
Complex conjugation here = product of two transpositions (even, ∈ A₅), NOT a transposition ⟹ Mathlib galActionHom_bijective_of_prime_degree (needs cardℂ=cardℝ+2) is INAPPLICABLE.

Disc(f)=2869=19·151, not a perfect square (verified) ⟹ G ⊄ A₅. But among transitive subgroups of S₅ only F₂₀ and S₅ contain odd perms (D₅ reflections are even), so disc-alone only gives G∈{F₂₀,S₅}; need 3∣|G| to finish.
Verified mod-p cycle types: irreducible mod 3,5,11,13 (5-cycle); mod 2,7 = (2,3) order-6 (σ³=transposition, σ²=3-cycle); mod 17=(1,1,3) 3-cycle; mod 23,29,31=(1,4) 4-cycle.
f is REDUCIBLE mod 2 (=(x²+x+1)(x³+x²+1)) so Selmer/mod-2 wont give irreducibility; use mod-3 irreducibility. Eisenstein inapplicable.

The order-divisibility half (5 ∣ |Gal|) of the Gal≅S₅ proof needs NO Dedekind–Frobenius bridge: prime_degree_dvd_card gives it for the real f.Gal directly from Irreducible f (prime-degree irreducible over char-0 field ⟹ transitive action on roots ⟹ deg ∣ |Gal|). Only the transposition input (frob2³, cycle type mod 2) remains genuinely bridge-dependent. Confirmed the real-roots/conjugation route stays a dead end (1 real root ⟹ conjugation even; galActionHom_bijective_of_prime_degree needs ≤3 non-real roots, f has 4).

Mathlib ALREADY proves the Selmer family: Polynomial.X_pow_sub_X_sub_one_irreducible_rat (RingTheory/Polynomial/Selmer.lean) gives Irreducible (X^n - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) for all n ≠ 1, via the unit-trinomial argument + Gauss's lemma. No mod-3 reduction needed — the prior plan to hand-build the mod-p irreducibility check was unnecessary.

The mod-3 quadratic-factor obstruction CAN be proved by coefficient comparison + decide over 3^5 cases (avoiding %ₘ), but the ZMod 3 kernel reduction is prohibitively slow (>19 min, killed). Would need native_decide (adds Lean.ofReduceBool axiom) — not worth it since Selmer makes it purely corroborative.

S(2026-06-19, researcher-12): The sole blocker (Dedekind–Frobenius bridge) reduces to ONE self-contained abstract Mathlib lemma with NO reference to q or the three_dvd_gal_card axiom: orderOf_arithFrobAt_eq_inertiaDegIn — at an unramified prime Q (ramificationIdxIn (Q.under R) S = 1), orderOf (arithFrobAt R G Q) = inertiaDegIn (Q.under R) S. CRITICAL: proving exists_gal_order_three directly via prove_file on the Dedekind companion is CIRCULAR — its import of three_dvd_gal_card + Cauchy (exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card, 3 prime) trivially closes the sorry. The abstract bridge lemma avoids this entirely.

INSTANTIATION is the real remaining gap (not the abstract bridge, which is done). The abstract bridge gives orderOf(arithFrobAt at Q)=inertiaDegIn(Q.under R). For the order-6 transposition route at p=2 one must work in S=𝓞_K with K the FULL splitting field (deg 120): there every prime over 2 is unramified with residue degree lcm(2,3)=6 (NOT 2 or 3 — those are the residue degrees in the deg-5 stem field ℚ(α), where f≡(deg2)(deg3)). So inertiaDegIn(2,𝓞_K)=6 is exactly what's needed, but deriving it from the mod-2 factor type requires the factorization↔inertia-degree correspondence, which a pin grep confirms is ABSENT from Mathlib v4.26 (no 'inertiaDeg…factor' / 'cycleType…Frobenius' lemma). Plus the galActionHom wiring (arithFrobAt ℤ f.Gal Q as a Perm(Fin 5) of matching cycle type) is itself unbuilt. This instantiation is the genuinely hard, ≫100-line, shared-with-a5-oq-01 work.

CONFIRMED in-pin (r12 grep of proofs/.lake mathlib v4.26): the Kummer–Dedekind PRODUCER half for the STEM field is fully available in Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/Ideal/KummerDedekind.lean — NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod (hp : ¬ p ∣ RingOfIntegers.exponent θ) bijects primes over p with monic irreducible factors of minpoly mod p, and inertiaDeg_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply equates each inertia degree with natDegree of the corresponding factor mod p. Also present: RingOfIntegers.exponent θ := absNorm (under ℤ (conductor ℤ θ)), exponent_eq_one_iff (= 1 ↔ Algebra.adjoin ℤ {θ} = ⊤), not_dvd_exponent_iff, ramificationIdx/ inertiaDeg symm_apply variants. This validates the r7 KummerDedekind lead at the API level.

SUB-GAP B SHARPENED (r12): instantiating the stem-field KummerDedekind producer at p=2 needs the hypothesis ¬ 2 ∣ exponent θ (monogenicity at 2). Mathlib v4.26 supplies NO ready disc→exponent bridge: not_dvd_exponent_iff only RESTATES ¬ p ∣ exponent θ as Codisjoint (comap (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) (conductor ℤ θ)) (span {↑p}) — the abstract Dedekind p-maximality condition, not derivable from the polynomial discriminant by an existing lemma. Algebra.discr_powerBasis_eq_prod/_eq_norm exist in RingTheory/Discriminant.lean but there is NO connector from disc(Z[θ]) squarefree (=2869, odd) to exponent θ (the index²|disc ⟹ index=1 argument is unformalized). So sub-gap B remains a genuine build, ~hundreds of lines, even though the producer (formerly thought absent) is present.

DOWNSTREAM HALF IS NOW FORMAL (r7): the conclusion X⁵−X−1 not solvable by radicals needs NONE of the open Frobenius bridge — it is a 4-line consequence of Gal≅S₅ via Mathlib Abel–Ruffini (solvableByRad.isSolvable′) + Equiv.Perm.fin_5_not_solvable. So OQ-07 cleanly splits: (open) the iso f.Gal ≅ S₅ [Dedekind–Frobenius, sub-gaps B+C]; (now verified) everything before it (5∣|Gal|, S₅ assembly) AND everything after it (unsolvability). The genuine open content is exactly the iso, nothing else.
mathlibGaps: AVAILABLE (was reported absent): factorization-mod-p <-> STEM-field inertia degrees. Mathlib v4.26 NumberField/Ideal/KummerDedekind.lean (Roblot 2025) provides NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod (primes over p <-> monic irreducible factors of minpoly mod p, for p not dividing RingOfIntegers.exponent theta) and inertiaDeg_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply (inertia degree = factor degree mod p). This discharges the 'producer' half of the old blocker for the stem field; it does NOT by itself give the splitting-field Frobenius cycle type.

ABSENT (sub-gap B): squarefree-discriminant => O_K = Z[alpha] (monogenicity), needed to get exponent theta = 1 and hence 2 not dividing exponent theta, the hypothesis of the Kummer-Dedekind lemmas at p=2. disc(f)=2869=19*151 is squarefree, but Mathlib v4.26 packages only the building block Algebra.discr_mul_isIntegral_mem_adjoin (RingTheory/Polynomial/Eisenstein/IsIntegral.lean), not the full implication.

ABSENT (sub-gap C): decomposition-group / Frobenius -> root-permutation cycle type (Dedekind's theorem). No decompositionGroup, FrobeniusElt, or arithFrobAt for number fields in Mathlib v4.26 NumberTheory; the stem-field inertia degrees {2,3} must be lifted to an order-6 (=lcm 2 3) element of the splitting field's Galois group realized as a Perm(Fin 5) of matching cycle type. This is the deepest remaining sub-gap, shared with inverse-galois-a5-oq-01.

Dedekind-Frobenius bridge (factor type of f mod unramified p ⟹ matching cycle type element in p.Gal as root-permutation) is NOT available in Mathlib v4.26.0. This is the sole blocker for a verified S₅ proof and is exactly the axiom three_dvd_gal_card (InverseGaloisA5.lean:309) the gallery A5 entry still carries; InverseGaloisA5Dedekind.lean is mid-attempt via IsArithFrobAt with a live sorry.

factorization↔inertiaDegIn: no theorem in pinned Mathlib v4.26 relating the degrees of the irreducible factors of f mod an unramified p to the inertia degrees of the primes over p (equivalently, to the cycle type of the Frobenius). Pin grep for 'inertiaDeg…factor' / 'cycleType…Frobenius' / 'natDegree…inertiaDeg' returns 0 hits. This is the concrete sub-gap blocking instantiation of the now-proved abstract bridge for BOTH abel-ruffini-oq-07 (needs inertiaDegIn(2)=6) and inverse-galois-a5-oq-01 (needs inertiaDegIn(7)=3).
nextSteps: BUILD sub-gap B (monogenicity at 2): prove ¬ 2 ∣ RingOfIntegers.exponent θ for θ a root of X⁵−X−1. Two candidate routes — (a) disc(Z[θ])=2869 odd ⟹ 2∤index²=disc/disc(O_K) ⟹ 2∤index ⟹ 2∤exponent, needs the index↔exponent and disc↔index bridges (both unformalized); (b) discharge not_dvd_exponent_iff directly via the Codisjoint/Dedekind p-maximality condition using f mod 2 squarefree = (X²+X+1)(X³+X²+1). Route (b) may be shorter and is the Mathlib-idiomatic path.
THEN instantiate primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod + inertiaDeg_..._symm_apply at p=2 over the stem field Q(α) to certify stem-field inertia degrees {2,3}; independently shippable verified lemma.

Sub-gap C (deepest, shared with inverse-galois-a5-oq-01): lift stem-field inertia {2,3} to an order-6 (=lcm) element of f.SplittingFields Gal realized as Perm(Fin 5) of matching cycle type (Dedekinds theorem on Frobenius cycle types). No decompositionGroup/FrobeniusElt for number fields in Mathlib v4.26 NumberTheory — likely the real BLOCKED frontier.
